text: 1 January 2027 is a Friday. On what day of the week does 1 January 2028 fall?
why: 2027 isn't a leap year, so 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day: one day on from Friday.

text: Of all the years from 2000 onwards, which one needs the fewest Roman numerals to write?
why: 2000 is just MM: two letters. Every later year adds at least one more.

text: A dromedary has one hump and a Bactrian camel has two. A herd of 5 camels has 7 humps. How many are Bactrian?
why: If all 5 had one hump there'd be 5; the 2 extra humps mean 2 Bactrians.

text: In a double-six set of dominoes, how many dominoes have at least one six on them?
On a dice, opposite faces add up to 7. Looking at a corner you can see 1, 2 and 3. What do the three hidden faces add up to?
In snooker, what's the most points you can score by potting one red and then one colour?
why: A red is worth 1 and the black, the most valuable colour, 7.
